_comment: Optional. Themed groups for the top level of the menu, used when navigation.useGroups is true. Each group becomes one non-clickable heading that opens a mega menu of its categories. Keep the list short - a SharePoint header bar shows about five or six entries before it starts hiding the rest behind a '...' overflow. Categories are listed by their DISPLAY name (see categories.json); any category not named in a group falls into defaultGroup. Delete the sample groups and write your own.
